title: aster puniceus f. lucidulus
intro: Aster puniceus f. lucidulus, commonly known as Purple Coneflower, is a flowering plant species that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving immune function, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as calming and soothing the body. The bioactive constituents of Aster puniceus f. lucidulus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, this plant has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin irritations.
